What Mien does, treatment by treatment

Each service below has its own page on the new site, so you can read exactly what it involves before you book — instead of guessing from a single list.

Hair

Aveda hair, cut and coloured with care

Aveda hair services in a salon setting, with styling for everyday wear and for occasions.

  • Hair-up: Top Stylist $170 / Senior $140 / Stylist $110
  • Occasion styling, booked by stylist level
Skin

DMK facials and IPL skin rejuvenation

DMK facials, plus IPL skin rejuvenation for skin that needs more than a standard facial. Lash lifts and brow lamination are also available.

  • DMK facials
  • IPL skin rejuvenation
  • Lash lifts and brow lamination
Body

Massage and body treatments

Massage styles include Swedish/Relaxation, Deep Tissue, Remedial, Reflexology, Acupressure, Chakra, Pregnancy and Hot Stone. Massage pricing is not published on the site — ask when you book.

  • Swedish/Relaxation, Deep Tissue, Remedial
  • Reflexology, Acupressure, Chakra, Pregnancy, Hot Stone
Hands & feet

Manicure and pedicure

Manicure and pedicure services, on their own or added to a spa package for a full visit.

Our story

An 1879 building, trading as Mien since 1999

Mien Salon & Spa sits in a heritage-listed 1879 building at 370 Queens Parade, Fitzroy North, and has been trading since 1999. That history is part of the visit: rooms with height and light, and treatments that are not hurried.

The new site gives every treatment its own page, so a first-time visitor can understand the difference between, for example, a DMK facial and IPL skin rejuvenation before picking up the phone.

Questions, answered plainly

How do I book?

By phone on (03) 9482 9199, by email to contact@mien.com.au, or through the booking form below, which opens your own email app addressed to Mien.

Are massage prices listed?

No — massage prices are not shown on Mien's website, so this page does not quote any. Ask for massage pricing when you call or email.

What if I am not sure which treatment suits me?

Start with the treatment pages under Services, then call or email with what you want to address. The team can point you to the right treatment before you book.

Where is Mien?

370 Queens Parade, Fitzroy North. Phone (03) 9482 9199.
